subject: Modular platform-floor + devops-retainer trade — proposal and SOW next steps
messages:
From: Elliot Harris <elliot.harris@acme-robotics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <psingh@acme-robotics.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Private VPC Commercial structure — quick clarifying Qs

Hey Connor,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the predictable tail-latency and KV cache behavior. Before we move pricing into procurement, finance has a couple of ask items:

1) Platform fee floor — we understand a baseline platform entitlement makes sense, but can you show us a model where the platform fee is phased in over 6–12 months tied to committed nodes rather than a single up-front annual floor?
2) DevOps retainer — we need clarity on included hours vs hourly overage and whether those hours can be repurposed for migration work.
3) Migration credit — can you make a short statement on how migration credits would be applied (one-time vs amortized)?

Also — any standard protection for early termination for customers who do not receive the documented SLOs? Finance wants a cap on exposure.

Appreciate a short proposal (high level numbers + SOW sketch) we can run past procurement tomorrow.

Thanks,
Elliot
--
Elliot Harris
Head of Platform Engineering, Acme Robotics
elliot.harris@acme-robotics.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Harris <elliot.harris@acme-robotics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC Commercial structure — quick clarifying Qs

Elliot — thanks for the clear questions. Short answer: yes, we can structure all three asks in a way that protects both sides. Below is an operational proposal we can convert into an SOW and a short-term amendment for pilot use.

Proposal (high level) — modular:
- Platform-floor phase: 3-stage ramp tied to committed capacity
  * Month 0–3 (pilot): 25% of published annual platform floor billed monthly as usage floor
  * Month 4–6 (onboarding): 50% of published annual platform floor billed monthly
  * Month 7–12: full platform floor unless a higher committed-node anchor is agreed
- DevOps retainer: 120 hours/quarter included as part of the onboarding tranche; additional hours billed at $225/hr. Up to 40% of quarterly hours may be reallocated to migration activity with 2-week advance notice.
- Migration credit: one-time credit equal to 40% of first-month platform-floor charge, amortized over the first 6 monthly invoices (customer accounting benefit). If Acme elects annual prepay, credit applies as immediate deduction on invoice.
- Early termination cap: customer exposure capped at 3 months of platform-floor charges after SOW-sign plus any non-cancellable third-party costs (e.g., hardware procurement).

Next steps: I attached a quick SOW sketch and a calculator for platform-floor scenarios. Ben / Marissa — can you weigh in on discount ladders for multi-year commit (we typically offer 10–25% depending on commit size)? Vanessa — any notes on how this maps to our standard support tiers and SLAs?

If that looks good to Elliot, I can convert to an SOW + amendment for signature and propose a procurement pack for ACME. Happy to hop on a 30-min call this afternoon.

Best,
Connor
--
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Elliot Harris <elliot.harris@acme-robotics.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 12:20:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Modular platform-floor + devops-retainer trade — proposal and SOW next steps

Agree with Connor's structure. A couple of commercial bullets from sales perspective:
- Discount ladder: we can offer 15% off platform-floor for a 12-month 1x committed-node equivalent (minimum 8 nodes). For a 24-month commit we move to 22%. These discounts phase in at the Month 4 transition so the pilot months are at list.
- One-time migration credit is contingent on a minimum 12-month commitment; otherwise we offer a smaller 10% credit.
- If Acme wants guaranteed 99.9% platform SLOs in the agreement, that requires on-call and a premium on the devops retainer. We should keep 99.5% as standard in the SOW and offer an SLO upgrade addendum.

I'll draft a short pricing table and include the two trade options (12m / 24m). Connor — please confirm how flexible we are on node minimums for the pilot.

Ben
--
Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 14:00:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Modular platform-floor + devops-retainer trade — proposal and SOW next steps

Looping in a packaging view and the attachments (SOW + calc). Key packaging decisions to be explicit in the SOW:
- SKU split: platform-floor SKU (recurring) + support tier SKU (recurring) + migration/implementation SKU (one-time).
- Support tiers: Standard (included, 24x5 email), Premium (SLA 4hr, includes NBD on-call, priced as % uplift on platform-floor).
- Engineering hours: specify which deliverables are included (migration runbook, live cutover, post-cutover stabilization) and a separate rate card for advisory work.

I attached a draft SOW that maps the ramp and the SLA upgrades. Also attached the platform-fee calculator with sample line-items to show total TCO under the 12m vs 24m scenarios.

Elliot / Priya — if you can confirm which packaging you prefer (Pilot-Only / 12m ramp / 24m commit) we'll produce a final SOW + signature-ready amendment.

Thanks,
Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Senior Commercial Manager, Redwood Inference

Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 16:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Modular platform-floor + devops-retainer trade — proposal and SOW next steps

Connor / team — this is helpful and close to what procurement wanted to see. A couple of follow-ups before we sign anything:

- Can you move the pilot node-minimum to 4 nodes for the first 90 days (we want to prove steady-state latency under our periodic burst patterns)?
- For early termination cap — can we agree on a cap equal to 2 months of platform-floor charges if Redwood misses the documented onboarding milestones (per SOW)?
- Please add a rollback clause for the migration in case the cutover causes >1% production error rate for more than 24 hours (we'd expect remediation credits).

If you can accept the three asks above, and send the updated SOW + 12m pricing table (the 12m option looks like the right baseline for us), we'll move this into legal for a quick review next week.

Happy to take a 30-min call if needed — propose Monday 10am ET.

Best,
Elliot
